categories.main_business_segments: Avary Holding primarily engages in the research, design, manufacturing, sales, and service of various types of printed circuit boards (PCBs). Its product portfolio includes communication boards, consumer electronics and computer boards, automotive and server boards, and other specialized PCBs. The company serves industries such as smartphones, network equipment, tablets, wearables, laptops, servers, automotive electronics, and AI servers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced PCB manufacturing technologies including flexible printed circuit boards (FPC), surface mount assembly (SMA), substrate-like PCBs (SLP), high-density interconnect (HDI), Mini LED, rigid PCBs (RPCB), and rigid-flex boards. It employs high-frequency, high-speed, and high-heat dissipation technologies, cavity technology, laser alignment, multi-layer roll-to-roll processes, and embedded component techniques. Digital transformation and AI applications are integrated into production for quality and efficiency improvements.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Avary Holding's primary customers are leading global electronic brands and electronic manufacturing service providers, especially in the smartphone and consumer electronics sectors. Key markets include communication electronics, consumer electronics, automotive electronics, AI servers, and high-performance computing. The company maintains long-term partnerships with top-tier domestic and international clients, including Foxconn and other major industry players.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant presence in China (including Shenzhen, Huai'an, Qinhuangdao), Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore, India, Japan, and Thailand. It serves customers primarily in the United States, Greater China, other Asian countries, and Europe. The company is expanding production capacity internationally, including a new manufacturing base in Thailand.
categories.supply_chain_position: Avary Holding operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of printed circuit boards. It is positioned as a key component provider bridging upstream raw materials and downstream electronic device assemblers and brand owners.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on developing high-end PCB technologies aligned with emerging trends such as AI, 5G/6G communications, automotive electrification, and new display technologies. R&D priorities include high-density interconnects, flexible and rigid-flex PCBs, high-frequency materials, embedded components, and green manufacturing processes. It invests heavily in innovation, digital transformation, and sustainability initiatives to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through customized product sales of printed circuit boards to global electronic brands and EMS providers. The company employs a direct sales model with order-based production, offering integrated solutions from design to manufacturing and after-sales service. It also receives government subsidies and investment income as supplementary revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Avary Holding is one of the world's largest PCB manufacturers, consistently ranked first in China and globally by revenue. It competes with other major PCB producers in the global electronics supply chain. Its competitive advantages include a broad product portfolio, strong R&D capabilities, high-quality standards, and long-term relationships with leading customers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 32.07 billion and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 3.29 billion, reflecting a decline compared to 2022 due to industry cyclicality. Total assets reached RMB 42.28 billion with steady growth in asset base. The company maintains healthy cash flow, a low debt ratio (~29.8%), and continues to invest significantly in R&D (6.1% of revenue).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Avary Holding emphasizes delivering high-reliability, high-density, high-frequency, and environmentally friendly PCB products tailored to customer specifications. It offers a one-stop service platform integrating R&D, design, manufacturing, and after-sales support. The company’s commitment to innovation, quality, rapid order response, and sustainability creates strong customer trust and competitive differentiation.
